label: Nantosuelta system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Nantosuelta locus represented by a VCA0322 profile that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Nantosuelta branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual VCA0322 genes, VCA0322 proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Nantosuelta locus, unresolved Nantosuelta trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
